item.title: AMD shares slide after weak data-center guidance
item.dc:creator: Therese Poletti
item.description:
Advanced Micro Devices Inc. cut its data-center revenue outlook for the fourth quarter, citing slower cloud spending & inventory digestion.

Shares fell 7% in premarket trading.

item.title: Boeing & Airbus deliveries slow as supply-chain snags persist
item.description: Boeing delivered 38 jets in August — down from 44 a year earlier & well short of its target.

item.title: Fed's Waller says more rate cuts are likely if the job market weakens
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said on Friday that further cuts are on the table.

item.title: TSMC to raise prices on advanced chips in 2027, Nvidia and Apple among customers hit
item.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing plans price increases of 5% to 10% for its most advanced nodes.
